learning_outcomes.text: Students will be able to analyze, design, and implement interactive and immersive 3D simulations adapted to the industrial context, while identifying and evaluating associated technical and methodological challenges.
They will know how to integrate hardware and software tools to address specific needs in virtual reality.

syllabus_topics: Definition and utility of virtual reality in industrial applications
Devices and hardware for immersion and interaction
Presentation of examples of virtual reality applications
Awareness of different formats and numerical methods used to handle 3D interactive data
Complexity for 3D objects and lighter 3D formats used
Practical work: Creation of interactive 3D simulations with OpenSpace3D (free and open-source software)
assessment_rules: The evaluation formula is (1*SOUT + 1*TP1) / 2. This implies an equal weighting for the oral presentation and practical work.
bibliography: Le traité de la réalité virtuelle ; Vol 1 à 4, P. Fuchs, G. Moreau, Les presses de l’Ecole des Mines, PARIS, Collection sciences mathématiques & informatiques, 2006.
Virtual Reality & Augmented Reality in Industry ; D. Ma, J. Gausemeier, X. Fan, M. Grafe, The 2nd Sino-German Workshop.
degree: Titre d'ingénieur ENIT (cycle ingénieur, semestres 5-10; orientación mecánica/producción)
